name: @thefuturesociety/pages-kit
description: Zero-dependency form elements for The Future Society's staff pages: <tfs-record-form>, <tfs-picker>, <tfs-rich-text>, <tfs-status-menu>, <tfs-delete-task>, <tfs-task-filters>, <tfs-kind>; power maps: <tfs-power-map>, <tfs-map-people>, <tfs-quick-contact>, <tfs-section>, <tfs-record-peek>, <tfs-view-switch>; plus task helpers (snooze rule, filters, exact counts) and autoRefresh (a page keeps itself current).
